label: Steam power
definition: Stationary and mobile steam engines as motive power for industry and transport

label: Power loom
definition: Mechanised weaving loom displacing hand-loom weavers

label: Shearing frame / gig mill
definition: Cloth-finishing machinery targeted by Luddite protests

label: Spinning machinery
definition: Water frame, spinning jenny, mule and successors

label: Agricultural machinery
definition: Reapers, threshers, harvesters and general farm mechanisation

label: Labour-saving machinery (unspecified)
definition: Umbrella category used when a source names no specific machine; 19th-century 'the machinery question'

label: Electricity / electrification
definition: Electric power generation and distribution as a production input

label: Automatic telephone exchange
definition: Strowger and successor automatic switching, displacing telephone operators

label: Tractor
definition: Internal-combustion farm traction, displacing horses and farm labour

label: Assembly line / mass production
definition: Moving assembly line and Fordist production methods

label: Mechanisation (unspecified)
definition: Umbrella for interwar 'rationalisation'/mechanisation claims naming no single machine

label: Computing
definition: Electronic digital computers as a general technology class

label: Automation (unspecified)
definition: Umbrella for 1950s-70s 'automation'/'cybernation' claims naming no specific system

label: Numerical control machine tools
definition: NC/CNC machine tools in manufacturing

label: Industrial robot
definition: Programmable manipulators in manufacturing (Unimate and successors)

label: Containerisation
definition: Standardised shipping containers, displacing longshore labour

label: Automated teller machine
definition: Cash-dispensing and self-service banking terminals

label: Microelectronics / the microchip
definition: Semiconductor microprocessors as a pervasive input (late-1970s 'chips' scare)

label: Word processor
definition: Dedicated and software word processing, displacing typists/secretaries

label: Telematics
definition: Computing + telecommunications convergence (Nora-Minc framing)

label: Expert system
definition: Rule-based decision systems of the 1980s AI wave

label: Personal computer
definition: Desktop computing in offices

label: Internet / e-commerce
definition: Networked digital communication and commerce

label: Artificial intelligence
definition: Machine performance of tasks requiring intelligence; umbrella for ML, expert systems, generative AI

label: Machine learning
definition: Statistical learning systems incl. deep learning; basis of 2010s automation-risk estimates

label: Autonomous vehicle
definition: Self-driving cars and trucks, displacing drivers

label: Generative AI
definition: Large language and diffusion models (ChatGPT era)
